# `assets/material/SegmentView.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/material/SegmentView.js`

engine/assets/material/SegmentView.js — non-destructive segmentation (spec §8).  We need modular breaking (swap tires, detach doors, tint glass, split a magazine) WITHOUT destroying the source. A SegmentView references original primitive ids / index ranges / materials — it never copies or rewrites geometry. A physical split is only baked later, on export or when a detachable part is actually created. This keeps skeletons, UVs, and morph targets intact.

## Functions

### `createSegmentView(model, mode = SEGMENT_MODE.MATERIAL)`

Create a non-destructive segment view of a model.

**Parameters:**

- `model` *(object)* — EngineModel
- `mode` *(string)* — one of SEGMENT_MODE

**Returns:** > }}

### `bakeSegment(model, segmentView, segmentKey)`

Bake a single segment into a standalone EngineModel-like payload (only when a detachable part is actually needed — e.g. export). Geometry is copied here, the source model is left untouched.

## Constants

- `SEGMENT_MODE`
